verdict.summary_en: Order confirmation OA26148191 from Karton Nowak for Soony Interactive GmbH's PO 4500318603 (dated 2025-12-30). It covers one line: item 00010, CMP-GAM-011 Activation Code Leaflet, 110,000 pcs at 0.03 EUR, confirmed for 2026-01-27. Terms are DAP Hamburg and NET30. The document has no handwriting, stamps or corrections.
observations: Printed, machine-generated PDF with no handwriting, stamps or signatures.
The quantity has no unit of measure printed.
No document date or total value is shown; the only dates are the PO date and the confirmed date.
Quantity '110,000' is read as 110000 (comma as thousands separator, since the unit price uses a dot decimal).
